title: Hunin operation results and transport envelopes

storage_scope.description: Stable browser-state namespace for explicit direct-store mode; null in registry mode.

status.description: Known labels include running, completed, failed and canceled; retained extension labels remain legal.

source.description: Retained source/build metadata is an extensible JSON value, including legacy scalar/null payloads.

correctness.description: Retained correctness evidence is an extensible JSON value; absence of a verified result must remain unknown.

total_weight.description: A non-finite floating-point aggregate serializes as null; it must not be relabeled as zero.

result_identity.description: Opaque identity of the selected-observation snapshot used for this summary. It is not a lease spanning later independent queries; older services may omit it.

summary_diagnostic.description: Why the independent summary is unavailable after the mutation result was retained.
Why the independent summary is unavailable after the mutation result was retained.

details.description: Legacy arbitrary JSON remains legal. When supplied, operation_error carries a checked typed-origin failure without request parameters.

launch_runtime.description: Backend-owned runtime argument for this registered collection mode. Older services may omit launch descriptors.

command_requirement.description: Backend-owned description of the target command this mode requires.

default_executable.description: Default workload interpreter/tool only when appropriate for this mode; a collector/probe executable is not a workload default.

selectable.description: Whether the registered launch path can be selected with a user command. This does not assert that the default probe passed or recording is verified.

import_formats.description: Optional for compatibility with older services. A present empty list means no advertised formats.

source_kind.description: Current labels include recorded_snapshot, current_file and recorded_source_map.

next_line.description: Start line for the next bounded source window, or null at the end. Older services may omit continuation metadata.

total_lines.description: Line count of the source bytes selected by this response; this is not proof of their mapping to built code.

items.description: Historical stored documents are arbitrary JSON; consumers must project known fields without inventing missing metadata.

status.description: Retains the stored attempt status value, including unknown legacy metadata.

items.description: Historical stored documents are arbitrary JSON; consumers must project known fields without inventing missing metadata.

comparable.description: Legacy alias for measurement_comparable, not workload equivalence. New clients should use the three explicitly named fields.

values_available.description: Both before and after contain numeric measurements. This does not establish measurement scope compatibility or equivalent workloads.

measurement_comparable.description: The pair satisfies this metric's measurement scope and quality checks. Independent of workload equivalence.

workload_comparable.description: Same value as Comparison.comparable: shared workload/settings/correctness checks passed. A single profiled pair still does not establish a speed improvement.

comparable.description: The recorded workload/settings/correctness comparison checks passed; independent metric availability/quality and repeated-measurement claim limits still apply.

OperationFailure.description: Machine-readable operation failure from a typed origin. Legacy transport messages remain unchanged; generic operation_failed is the fallback for uncategorized failures.

ImportFormat.description: Supported decoder input metadata, not proof of external prerequisite availability.

size_bytes.description: Exact decimal bytes when known; no floating point conversion.

result_identity.description: Opaque selected-result ID snapshot, independently read from run metadata; no cross-query lease.

total_weight.description: A non-finite floating-point aggregate serializes as null; it must not be relabeled as zero.

MutationSummary.description: Independent mutation summary, or null when selected aggregate work is unavailable; null never means measured zero.

code_id.description: Optional identity of a distinct observed code instance within this counting recording.

code_address_basis.description: Declared basis of the byte coordinate, for example runtime_pc, validated_arm64_callsite_from_return_address, or collector_adjusted_lookup_address. This does not establish instruction boundaries or execution cost.

recording_diagnostics.description: Recording-level collection and import diagnostics, which can include earlier attempts. These messages are historical context, not a typed cause or a completeness claim about this anchor.
